payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation, specifically through section title embeddings (STE) and classified section title embeddings (classified STE).

claims.text: Section titles are encoded using section title embeddings (STE) and classified section title embeddings (classified STE), which are generated by feeding tokenized section titles into a TLM and summing the last hidden states.
Classified STEs replace intraclass section title embeddings with the embedding of their corresponding class, while original STEs are used for titles that do not belong to any class.
The hierarchical structure information, including section titles, is injected into the summarization model to enhance sentence representations.
